name: LV5FU2 (de Gramont)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
source.nccnTemplate: pending - per-disease NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template not yet provided

institution.provenance: textbook-grounded draft; NCCN per-disease template + clinical (StewardMD) + hospital/institutional approval pending

supportiveCare: antiemetics: low emetic risk regimen (5-fluorouracil and leucovorin) per NCCN Appendix D - low-risk prophylaxis (e.g. single-agent 5-HT3 antagonist or dexamethasone) is typical; confirm against institutional antiemesis protocol

G-CSF: not called out as high/intermediate febrile-neutropenia risk in the source text; per NCCN Appendix C, low-risk regimens are not assigned routine prophylactic CSF - physician judgment for patient-specific risk factors
monitoring: renal function periodically (5-FU dose adjustment for renal impairment)

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123478: 'LV 200 mg/m2 over 2 hr days 1 and 2'.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123478-123479: 'followed by bolus 5-FU 400 mg/m2/day 1 and 2'. Given after leucovorin per NCCN Appendix F sequencing convention (LV followed by 5-FU).

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123479: 'followed by 5-FU 600 mg/m2 over 22 hr days 1 and 2; cycle repeated every 14 d'. Given after the 5-FU bolus per NCCN Appendix F sequencing convention.
